Teleportation: Dracula's favored strategy, used to confuse his enemy while he casts a myriad of offensive spells. Some versions of his teleporting has him blending to black lights, others turns him into many bats, but the function and strategy is one and the same., Hellfire: Fires a wall of fireballs from his cape. Another version causes flames to erupt from the floor., Power of Dominance: Dracula's primary ability allows him to absorb defeated monster's souls and enslave them. This power was the one that Soma Cruz, Dracula's incarnation, inherited along with Dracula's soul. While Soma can only summon monsters for a short amount of time due to his low magical power, Dracula can fully utilize this ability with infinite power from the stream of Chaos he commands., Dark Inferno: Fires magma fireballs from his cape. Unlike Hellfire, the meteors produced by this spell cannot be destroyed., Dark Metamorphosis: Boosts Dracula's Blood draining ability. He can bite an enemy or grasp them and drain their life. He rarely does the latter though, Soul Steal: : A spell that many fear. Soul Steal is used by Dracula and to kill and absorb their energy for Dracula's use. The one version of the spell has an area of effect around the caster. It can effect multiple victims multiple times in one cast. Another version drains the life out of Dracula's victims by a mere touch, which is why many fear this spell. It is also referred to as Life Steal., Blood Storm: Perhaps as a way of mocking of the Belmonts' powers, could make it rain blood, Meteors: During the events in Circle of The Moon, Dracula displayed various powerful magic spells, one of which summons a barrage of flaming meteors to rain down from the sky onto his enemy., Dominus Hatred / Fatal Ray: Dracula summons seven green rays of dark energy that fly upward from his body. After a moment, the rays fall, covering the entire area although leaving some spaces between where the player can dodge them. He uses this attack in various games, including Castlevania Chronicles and Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin, although its most prominent appearance is in Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia., Destruction Ray: A dire version of the Fatal Ray. Dracula summons seven purple rays of dark energy that fly upward from his body, but this time they fall following the player's movement., Dark Void: Dracula's favored move. He teleports becoming a black mist and many bats appearing anywhere he desires. Its best to do multiple Dark Voids to confuse enemies., Demonic Meggido: Dracula's ultimate dark spell. Two version of this attack are in existence. The first, and more common version has a shorter charging time and allows Dracula to charge demonic runes that become a giant black fireball. Dracula can throw it to his victim and will incinerate his victims with demonic fire. The second version is a gigantic explosion, with Dracula as its nucleus. The explosion radiates from him, dealing heavy damage with high likelihood of killing his opponent. However, the second version requires a longer time to charge, giving enough time to either escape or defeat him before he can use it while draining Dracula's health. On Order of Ecclesia it is shown that Dracula can sustain it for as long as desires, while in Harmony of Despair its effect is shown to cease, with locations such as Brauner's paintings appearing in the animated series and are treated as alternative worlds

Teleportation: Dracula's favored strategy, used to confuse his enemy while he casts a myriad of offensive spells. Some versions of his teleporting has him blending to black lights, others turns him into many bats, but the function and strategy is one and the same., Hellfire: Fires a wall of fireballs from his cape. Another version causes flames to erupt from the floor., Power of Dominance: Dracula's primary ability allows him to absorb defeated monster's souls and enslave them. This power was the one that Soma Cruz, Dracula's incarnation, inherited along with Dracula's soul. While Soma can only summon monsters for a short amount of time due to his low magical power, Dracula can fully utilize this ability with infinite power from the stream of Chaos he commands., Dark Inferno: Fires magma fireballs from his cape. Unlike Hellfire, the meteors produced by this spell cannot be destroyed., Dark Metamorphosis: Boosts Dracula's Blood draining ability. He can bite an enemy or grasp them and drain their life. He rarely does the latter though, Soul Steal: : A spell that many fear. Soul Steal is used by Dracula and to kill and absorb their energy for Dracula's use. The one version of the spell has an area of effect around the caster. It can effect multiple victims multiple times in one cast. Another version drains the life out of Dracula's victims by a mere touch, which is why many fear this spell. It is also referred to as Life Steal., Blood Storm: Perhaps as a way of mocking of the Belmonts' powers, could make it rain blood, Meteors: During the events in Circle of The Moon, Dracula displayed various powerful magic spells, one of which summons a barrage of flaming meteors to rain down from the sky onto his enemy., Dominus Hatred / Fatal Ray: Dracula summons seven green rays of dark energy that fly upward from his body. After a moment, the rays fall, covering the entire area although leaving some spaces between where the player can dodge them. He uses this attack in various games, including Castlevania Chronicles and Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin, although its most prominent appearance is in Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia., Destruction Ray: A dire version of the Fatal Ray. Dracula summons seven purple rays of dark energy that fly upward from his body, but this time they fall following the player's movement., Dark Void: Dracula's favored move. He teleports becoming a black mist and many bats appearing anywhere he desires. Its best to do multiple Dark Voids to confuse enemies., Demonic Meggido: Dracula's ultimate dark spell. Two version of this attack are in existence. The first, and more common version has a shorter charging time and allows Dracula to charge demonic runes that become a giant black fireball. Dracula can throw it to his victim and will incinerate his victims with demonic fire. The second version is a gigantic explosion, with Dracula as its nucleus. The explosion radiates from him, dealing heavy damage with high likelihood of killing his opponent. However, the second version requires a longer time to charge, giving enough time to either escape or defeat him before he can use it while draining Dracula's health. On Order of Ecclesia it is shown that Dracula can sustain it for as long as desires, while in Harmony of Despair its effect is shown to cease, with locations such as Brauner's paintings appearing in the animated series and are treated as alternative worlds

Extraordinary Genius (Ikora is one of the most intelligent Guardians in the Last City and the leader of the Warlocks. She has extensive knowledge on the enemies of the City such as the Vex and Hive, and she has her spy network investigate their weaknesses. She studied under Osiris, who is the most intelligent Guardian in history. Her knowledge and expertise is considered necessary by her fellow Vanguard members, Cayde and Zavala, and commands respect from other Warlocks.Warlock Vanguard She's an expert in the fields of physics and mathematics, metaphysics and ontology, and likely many more.Destiny 2: Witch Queen Collector's Edition: Hidden DossierThe Hidden Dossier Designed a portal that was specifically attuned to the Undying Mind, so that its copies could all be summoned from different realities and timesVex Invasion | Patternbreaking | Season of the UndyingVex Offensive: Final Assault | To Destroy A Mind | Season of the UndyingVex Offensive: To Destroy a Mind | The Undying Mind: Introduction | Season of the Undying)

Gaurdians lose all of their Light based abilities if their connection to the Light is severed. Destroying Ikora's Ghost will prevent her from being able to resurrect or regenerate. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Blink: Allows Ikora to teleport a short distance. *Glide: Warlocks are capable of gliding through the air with varying control over their movement, speed, and height. *Vortex Grenade: A grenade which continuously damages enemies with Void Light that are inside of the area of effect. *Axion Bolt: A grenade which creates homing particles of Void Light which seek out enemies. *Scatter Grenade: A grenade which creates several smaller explosions for Void Light that covers a larger area of effect. *Healing Rift: Creates a rift of Light which heals allies and Ikora inside. *Empowering Rift: Creates a rift of Light which greatly increases the attack potency of allies and Ikora inside. *Entropic Pull: A melee ability which absorbs the target's life force to recharge Ikora's grenade energy. *Chaos Accelerant: Ikora can draw from her Super energy to increase the potency of her grenade abilities. *Bloom: Enemies that Ikora kills explode with Void Light. *Cataclysm: Ikora's Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks out enemies, but she can also detonate the bomb early to create several smaller homing projectiles. *Devour: Striking an enemy with this melee ability fully restores all of Ikora's health. *Feel the Void: Ikora is capable of consuming her grenade energy to restore her health. While the Devour effect is active with this ability, anything Ikora kills will fully restore her health. Devour lasts 9 seconds, but it is reset with every kill Ikora gains. *Insatiable: Kills Ikora gains while Devour is active recharge her grenade energy. *Vortex: When Ikora uses Nova Bomb, it creates a singularity which traps enemies inside dealing continuous damage with Void Light. *Void Breach: This melee ability can hit at a further range with an explosion of Void Light. *Handheld Supernova: Converts grenade energy into a short range Void Light blast. *Dark Matter: Health and melee, grenade and class ability energy are gained for each Void energy kill. *Nova Bomb: Ikora throws a huge blast of Void Light at her enemy which disintegrates the opponent. *Nova Warp: Ikora moves between dimensions to teleport and appear in a huge explosion of Void Light. ==Gallery== Gaurdians lose all of their Light based abilities if their connection to the Light is severed. Destroying Ikora's Ghost will prevent her from being able to resurrect or regenerate. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Blink: Allows Ikora to teleport a short distance. *Glide: Warlocks are capable of gliding through the air with varying control over their movement, speed, and height. *Vortex Grenade: A grenade which continuously damages enemies with Void Light that are inside of the area of effect. *Axion Bolt: A grenade which creates homing particles of Void Light which seek out enemies. *Scatter Grenade: A grenade which creates several smaller explosions for Void Light that covers a larger area of effect. *Healing Rift: Creates a rift of Light which heals allies and Ikora inside. *Empowering Rift: Creates a rift of Light which greatly increases the attack potency of allies and Ikora inside. *Entropic Pull: A melee ability which absorbs the target's life force to recharge Ikora's grenade energy. *Chaos Accelerant: Ikora can draw from her Super energy to increase the potency of her grenade abilities. *Bloom: Enemies that Ikora kills explode with Void Light. *Cataclysm: Ikora's Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks out enemies, but she can also detonate the bomb early to create several smaller homing projectiles. *Devour: Striking an enemy with this melee ability fully restores all of Ikora's health. *Feel the Void: Ikora is capable of consuming her grenade energy to restore her health. While the Devour effect is active with this ability, anything Ikora kills will fully restore her health. Devour lasts 9 seconds, but it is reset with every kill Ikora gains. *Insatiable: Kills Ikora gains while Devour is active recharge her grenade energy. *Vortex: When Ikora uses Nova Bomb, it creates a singularity which traps enemies inside dealing continuous damage with Void Light. *Void Breach: This melee ability can hit at a further range with an explosion of Void Light. *Handheld Supernova: Converts grenade energy into a short range Void Light blast. *Dark Matter: Health and melee, grenade and class ability energy are gained for each Void energy kill. *Nova Bomb: Ikora throws a huge blast of Void Light at her enemy which disintegrates the opponent. *Nova Warp: Ikora moves between dimensions to teleport and appear in a huge explosion of Void Light. ==Gallery== Oryx's weapon of choice, an enormous ascendant sword that is used to activate the Dreadnaught's super weapon. Willbreaker's edge is sharp enough to cut through quarks and as its name suggests, it can break the wills of others. Its blade is not dulled by age. Each death it trades for life hones its edge, gives it weight and gravitas and insistence within the vortex of its own totality. Willbreaker transcends liminality. It does not have to touch you to wound you. And lastly to be taken in Willbreaker's grasp is to be simplified; that is, to be reduced to one's most basic level, shedding all higher-order thoughts of fear or duty or selfishness; that is, to feel only pain. After slaying Akka, Oryx took from the Worm God's remains the secret to call upon the Deep (the Darkness). He wrote this secret upon a set of tablets, which he called the Tablets of Ruin. From the secrets written upon these tablets, Oryx learned about the power to Take. With the Tablets of Ruin he could also commune with the Deep and travel to it, when no other Hive could. DreadnaughtGrimoire.jpg|The Dreadnaught, accompanied by multiple Hive warships DreadnaughtCinematic.jpg|The Dreadnaught after its super weapon annihilated the Awoken fleet DreadnaughtSaturn.jpg|The Dreadnaught positioned within the hole it blew in Saturn's ring The Dreadnaught is Oryx's flagship. It was made from a piece of the Worm God Akka's corpse and is enormous in size, dwarfing even Hive warships. Oryx's throne world is housed by the Dreadnaught, giving him the advantage of having a mobile realm. The ship's hull is so durable that it was completely unaffected by the impact of multiple Harbingers, the Awoken's super weapons, which were tearing through the Hive fleet prior. Through the power of the Deep and clever systems built into the Dreadnaught by his daughters, Oryx can push part of his throne world into reality in order to decimate anything within range. This is the ship's paracausal super weapon.

Oryx's weapon of choice, an enormous ascendant sword that is used to activate the Dreadnaught's super weapon. Willbreaker's edge is sharp enough to cut through quarks and as its name suggests, it can break the wills of others. Its blade is not dulled by age. Each death it trades for life hones its edge, gives it weight and gravitas and insistence within the vortex of its own totality. Willbreaker transcends liminality. It does not have to touch you to wound you. And lastly to be taken in Willbreaker's grasp is to be simplified; that is, to be reduced to one's most basic level, shedding all higher-order thoughts of fear or duty or selfishness; that is, to feel only pain. After slaying Akka, Oryx took from the Worm God's remains the secret to call upon the Deep (the Darkness). He wrote this secret upon a set of tablets, which he called the Tablets of Ruin. From the secrets written upon these tablets, Oryx learned about the power to Take. With the Tablets of Ruin he could also commune with the Deep and travel to it, when no other Hive could. DreadnaughtGrimoire.jpg|The Dreadnaught, accompanied by multiple Hive warships DreadnaughtCinematic.jpg|The Dreadnaught after its super weapon annihilated the Awoken fleet DreadnaughtSaturn.jpg|The Dreadnaught positioned within the hole it blew in Saturn's ring The Dreadnaught is Oryx's flagship. It was made from a piece of the Worm God Akka's corpse and is enormous in size, dwarfing even Hive warships. Oryx's throne world is housed by the Dreadnaught, giving him the advantage of having a mobile realm. The ship's hull is so durable that it was completely unaffected by the impact of multiple Harbingers, the Awoken's super weapons, which were tearing through the Hive fleet prior. Through the power of the Deep and clever systems built into the Dreadnaught by his daughters, Oryx can push part of his throne world into reality in order to decimate anything within range. This is the ship's paracausal super weapon.

Genius (Rhulk is a prodigy in combat, able to defeat multiple Lubraean soldiers, while unarmed and at a young age. After acquiring a glaive of his own, he went on to kill many more soldiers. Was able to manipulate and mold a civilization from behind the scenes with only one person ever becoming aware of his existence. Appropriated the Lucent Hive's runes, learning their magic and using it for his own experiments, successfully merging a Scorn and a WormThis Week In Destiny – 05/02/2024)

Rhulk is very arrogant and will underestimate those he deems as lesser than him. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Resonance: As Darkness is something that hums and flows and resonates, Resonance is the basis of all its manifestations. A core part of its identity is the manipulation of waves. Resonance can manipulate the rules and information of reality through its influence over the protological patterns, the common language, that underpins them. Rhulk can apply this power in a wide variety of ways. Rhulk has demonstrated numerous uses, including: walking on air, creating various force fields, amplifying his attacks, high-speed dashes, forming weapons, distorting space-time, creating portals, teleportation, manipulating technology, mending broken objects and healing himself. **Suns of Lubrae: Rhulk emits beams of light, followed by an oscillating, double helix manifesting along each beam. These attacks deal Solar damage and inflict the Pervading Darkness debuff. **Savage Strike: Rhulk performs a physical strike, imbued with Resonance, capable of killing even the most powerful Guardians in one hit. This attack deals Solar damage and inflicts the Pervading Darkness debuff. **Pervading Darkness: A debuff that obscures the target's perception with darkness and eventually kills them through Umbral Suffocation, permanently snuffing out the Light of even the most powerful Guardians. Rhulk can apply this debuff through attacks, by creating Resonant spikes that apply it over a large area, or simply as a side-effect of fighting at full power. ==Gallery== File:RhulkThumb.jpg|Official art of Rhulk File:RhulkReveal2.jpg|Rhulk appears. Standard Equipment |- | Perfect_Paradox.png|Perfect Paradox Bastion.jpg|Bastion Saint.PNG|Helm of Saint-14 SaintGrayPigeon.jpg|Satin-14's Gray Pigeon * Perfect Paradox: The Perfect Paradox is a Void rapid-fire shotgun that was created by the Guardian and given to Saint-14 inside the Infinite Forest, and was at a later date recovered from the body of Saint-14 to be reforged by the Guardian, which was then given to Saint-14 when the Guardian travelled into the Infinite Forest. The Perfect Paradox fires at 140RPM and has a magazine of 7, with each shot firing 12 pellets, as well as a series of adjustable barrel, sight, magazine and battery options and the trait 'Rampage' which increases the strength of the Perfect Paradox with the number of enemies killed with it for a short period of time (Stacks to a maximum of x3). * Bastion: Bastion is an Exotic kinetic-damage fusion rifle gifted to Saint-14 by the Speaker, it fires 3 spreads of kinetic slugs, with part of the weapons' damage bypassing shields of enemies. This weapon has a durable ranged barrel, a slow-building charge to increase the impact of the burst and a versatile dual-purpose stock. * Helm of Saint-14: The Helm of Saint-14 is an Exotic helmet that has the special perk 'Starless Night', which blinds enemies that enter Saint-14's Ward of Dawn as well as temporarily blinding nearby enemies when Saint-14 guards with his Sentinel Shield. * Ghost: For a Guardian, their Ghost serves as a companion, scout, librarian, and mechanic, able to activate ancient machinery and act as a codebreaker. Ghosts can support Guardians by performing certain actions such as illuminating darkened areas, repairing technology, scanning for and informing Guardians of incoming hostile threats, and providing communications. Most importantly, Ghosts may revive Guardians from death. As long as the Ghost survives, and barring special circumstances, Guardians are effectively immortal and can be resurrected fully intact from any form of death without consequences. The death does not have to be immediate, nor do they have to be revived in the same place they died. Ghosts may also repair any injury a Guardian suffers in a matter of seconds. *Sparrow: A Sparrow is a single-passenger, all-terrain antigrav bike with one purpose: moving from objective to objective with unmatched speed. Sparrows are quick, quiet, and simple to transmat. *Saint-14's Gray Pigeon: A one-seat Guardian jumpship, Saint-14's personal aircraft uses a City-standard NLS Drive that bends space around the vehicle for almost instantaneous travel between planets. Suitable for both vacuum and in-atmosphere operations; can be left in orbit and teleported to or from at any time per a Guardian's need. |}

At least Above Average (As the first Vanguard Commander, Saint-14 would need an impressive degree of intelligence, as this position requires the user to be able to manage almost everything going on in The City and with other Guardians. In terms of fighting, Saint-14 has quite an impressive record, with him being hailed for his actions at the Battle of Six Fronts, his successful crusades against the Fallen, and fighting the Vex for centuries on end, even killing the mind specifically designed to kill him. Ghosts are likely around Extraordinary Genius, as they are companion supercomputers capable of deciphering information incomprehensible to normal minds)

Gaurdians lose all of their Light based abilities if their connection to the Light is severed. Destroying Saint's Ghost will prevent him from being able to resurrect or regenerate. Feats: *Became famous for his actions at the Battle of Six Fronts. *Became the first Vanguard, and helped establish the Consensus system that still runs The City in present. *Led crusades against the Fallen, resulting in the death of Solkis, Kell of the House of Devils. *Fought the Vex for centuries, ending his life with a mutual kill on a mind dedicated to the sole purpose of his demise. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Lift: A Titan ability allowing for limited flight. Can be altered to prioritize height, control, or giving a strong burst of initial momentum. *Towering Barricade: A large barrier that can be used for cover or to seal off dangerous areas for a short time. *Rally Barricade: A small barricade that allows one to peek over it while aiming down sights and continuously reloads the equipped weapon of the user. *Titan Codices: Titan training allows them to select from a vast variety of fighting styles that focus on a mixture of recovery, speed and toughness. Different codices will focus on one, two or all of the three traits, amplifying them in the user depending on which traits the user needs in any specific battle. *Sentinel Shield: Summons a shield of Void Light. While Sentinel Shield is active, the user can hit opponents with the shield, throw the shield while creating a new one in the process, or guard with the shield, greatly expanding the radius it covers. Sentinel Shield is incredibly difficult to break through even using other Guardian supers and erases things at a touch. *Disintegrate: Killing an enemy with this melee ability creates a Force Barrier around the user which absorbs incoming damage. This ability can be tweaked to also allow every melee kill to have a chance of generating an Orb of Light, have the Force Barrier continually recharge or have the reload and ready speed of weapons be extremely quick while Force Barrier is active. Extra perks allow the user to increases the duration and strength of the shield created by Disintegrate. *Magnetic Grenade: A grenade that attaches to enemies and explodes twice. Designed to crack the armour of hard targets. *Spike Grenade: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging void light. *Suppressor Grenade: An explosive grenade that prevents enemies from using abilities for a short time. *Voidwall Grenade: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light. *Iron Harvest: Heavy Weapon kills have a chance to create Orbs of Light for the users allies. Code of the Protector: *Ward of Dawn: The Code of the Protector allows the user to forego summoning the Sentinel Shield, and instead shape Void Light into a nigh-indestructible shield-dome to protect the user and their allies from harm. Replenishes grenade and melee energy on activation. Ward of Dawn can be tweaked to dramatically amplify the durability or attack potency of its user and any allies who pass through it, with other perks further increasing the potency of the buffs. Extra perks allow the user to either increase the Ward of Dawn's duration as well as their own base durability, give the Ward the ability to generate additional Orbs of Light when it is under enemy fire or dramatically decrease the cooldown time of the Ward of Dawn and give a small boost to the users base durability. *Defensive Strike: Killing an enemy with this melee ability to creates an overshield around the user and nearby allies. *Rallying Force: Killing an enemy in melee restores health for the user and nearby allies. *Turn the Tide: The overshield from Defensive Strike lasts longer and increases melee damage and reload speed. Code of the Aggressor: *Superior Arsenal: Grenade kills recharge grenade energy. *Shield Bash: After sprinting for a short time, using this melee ability unleashes a devastating Shield Bash that disorients enemies. *In The Trenches: Kills while surrounded by enemies reduce the cooldown of Sentinel Shield *Second Shield: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active. *Hammer of Sol: Forges Light into a raging inferno of Solar energy, and allows the user to pull a blazing hammer from the fire. The user can then launch their hammers at enemies from afar, releasing a devastating eruption of Solar fire on impact. Perks give the user the ability to throw more hammers as well as the hammers causing bigger explosions and allow the user to hurl themselves forward during Hammer of Sol, causing enemies in their path explode, chaining fiery damage to other enemies. Extra perks cause enemies that are killed by the Hammer of Sol to explode and chain fiery Solar damage to enemies caught in the blast or have the Hammer of Sol track its target. *Fleetfire: An extra perk that causes kills with solar abilities to grant the user bonus movement and reload speed for a short time. Cannot fight in spirit form in lower dimensions, and requires a physical vessel to not shatter it. Notable Attacks/Techniques: Authority ( Kennō): As a Primordial Goddess, Ishtar possess Divine Authorities, special powers distinct from Code Casts, Noble Phantasms, and Skills in that while they achieve results based on some logical process or principle, an Authority realizes a result simply because the user has the right to do so. Authorities are powers on the level of world construction, and can be powers such as event shifting, time manipulation, causality manipulation, kingdom-building and other powers on that level. The Gods originally used their Authorities during the Age of Gods to shape the world, build kingdoms and advance civilization. But as time went, humanity advanced to the point that Authorities became unnecessary. When summoned as a Servant, Ishtar likely cannot utilize her Authorities without harming and straining herself. The derivative version of Ishtar from our world possesses a total of seven Divine Authorities, and she also can take the Authorities of other Gods and Goddesses, and the primordial version of Ishtar should at least possess these as well. ===Noble Phantasm=== Edin Shugra Quasar: Royal Crown Shining in the Primeval Universe ( Edin Shugura Kuēsā?) Space Ishtar's own Noble Phantasm. She begins by summoning the ancient Bel Maanna temple, the "testimony of the goddess" from the primordial universe, before unleashing the higher-dimensional soul that composes it and generating an entire galaxy to turn into energy, firing it as a volatile projectile with enough power to obliterate entire cosmic domains. The temple, a Baal temple built by Anat, has a horrifying shape and offensive form, or so it is said. In the Sumer-Akkad language, "Edin" refers to the sky, and is said to be the source of the Old Testament's Eden. Shugra was the crown found in said Edin, given to Ishtar when she entered the domain. Quasar refers to the modern word for interstellar objects, a cosmic domain away from the Earth, emitting an extremely strong light and being called "the brightest celestial body". ===Class Skills=== *Avenger ( Fukushū-sha): The signature class skill of Avengers, representing the existence of one who gathers the grudges and hatred of others and takes it onto themselves. By chance, Ishtar's name of Astarte was corrupted by later Europe into the demon Astaroth, turning her from a goddess who was worshipped into a monster who was demonized. Filled with anger, pain and self-pity, her rank in this skill is an astounding EX. *Independent Action ( Tandoku Kōdō): The ability to remain independent and exist in the world without the magical energy supplied by a Master, allowing the Servant to act autonomously and the Master to save their own magical energy for spells. As an individual born as a goddess, raised as a human, and developed as a Servant, Ishtar's existence in the world takes virtually no mana, even when she's not contracted to a Master. *Magic Resistance ( Tai-Maryoku): An innate ability that grants protection against magical effects. Unlike the Resistance effect that merely rejects Magical Energy, this ability cancels the spells altogether. Ishtar's mediocre C-rank protects her from spells with two verses or less, but will be unable to protect her from High-Thaumaturgy or Greater Rituals. *Oblivion Correction ( Bōkyaku Hosei): An Avenger never forgets, attacking from beyond oblivion with greater strength than other Servants, increasing the power of their blows whenever they strike an opponent's weak points. No matter how much time passes or how many things she's exposed to, Ishtar's own hatred will never lessen. *Self-Replenishment (Mana) ( () Jiko Kaifuku (Maryoku)): One of the class skills of the Avenger, allowing them to continuously replenish their mana until their task is completed. ===Personal Skills=== * Devil's Sugar (デビルズ・シュガー Debiruzu Shugā): Even with her status as a demon paining her, Ishtar still makes full use of its "charm and excitement" with this skill. By smiling and blowing a kiss, she can increase her allies' morale and allow them to ignore any of their body's limitations to release power beyond their normal limits. Her own charm/curse is also capable of nullifying an enemy's charm when used on her allies. In a combination of the goddess of victory and the one who will destroy humanity, it could be called a devil's charisma. *Goddess' Divine Core (の Megami no Kamikaku): A skill that denotes Ishtar as a perfected goddess from birth, it preserves the absoluteness of her mind and body, repelling all mental interference while preventing her body from ageing or changing no matter how many calories she consumes. It's a composite skill that also includes divinity allowing her to reduce "Anti-Purge defense" in proportion to the rank of her Divinity, allowing her to break through defensive abilities such as Protection of the Faith and Saver's Enlightenment of the Sacred Fig.

Different codices will focus on one, two or all of the three traits, amplifying them in the user depending on which traits the user needs in any specific battle. *Sentinel Shield: Summons a shield of Void Light. While Sentinel Shield is active, the user can hit opponents with the shield, throw the shield while creating a new one in the process, or guard with the shield, greatly expanding the radius it covers. Sentinel Shield is incredibly difficult to break through even using other Guardian supers and erases things at a touch. *Disintegrate: Killing an enemy with this melee ability creates a Force Barrier around the user which absorbs incoming damage. This ability can be tweaked to also allow every melee kill to have a chance of generating an Orb of Light, have the Force Barrier continually recharge or have the reload and ready speed of weapons be extremely quick while Force Barrier is active. Extra perks allow the user to increases the duration and strength of the shield created by Disintegrate. *Magnetic Grenade: A grenade that attaches to enemies and explodes twice. Designed to crack the armour of hard targets. *Spike Grenade: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging void light. *Suppressor Grenade: An explosive grenade that prevents enemies from using abilities for a short time. *Voidwall Grenade: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light. *Iron Harvest: Heavy Weapon kills have a chance to create Orbs of Light for the users allies. Code of the Protector: *Ward of Dawn: The Code of the Protector allows the user to forego summoning the Sentinel Shield, and instead shape Void Light into a nigh-indestructible shield-dome to protect the user and their allies from harm. Replenishes grenade and melee energy on activation. Ward of Dawn can be tweaked to dramatically amplify the durability or attack potency of its user and any allies who pass through it, with other perks further increasing the potency of the buffs. Extra perks allow the user to either increase the Ward of Dawn's duration as well as their own base durability, give the Ward the ability to generate additional Orbs of Light when it is under enemy fire or dramatically decrease the cooldown time of the Ward of Dawn and give a small boost to the users base durability. *Defensive Strike: Killing an enemy with this melee ability to creates an overshield around the user and nearby allies. *Rallying Force: Killing an enemy in melee restores health for the user and nearby allies. *Turn the Tide: The overshield from Defensive Strike lasts longer and increases melee damage and reload speed. Code of the Aggressor: *Superior Arsenal: Grenade kills recharge grenade energy. *Shield Bash: After sprinting for a short time, using this melee ability unleashes a devastating Shield Bash that disorients enemies. *In The Trenches: Kills while surrounded by enemies reduce the cooldown of Sentinel Shield *Second Shield: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active. *Hammer of Sol: Forges Light into a raging inferno of Solar energy, and allows the user to pull a blazing hammer from the fire. The user can then launch their hammers at enemies from afar, releasing a devastating eruption of Solar fire on impact. Perks give the user the ability to throw more hammers as well as the hammers causing bigger explosions and allow the user to hurl themselves forward during Hammer of Sol, causing enemies in their path explode, chaining fiery damage to other enemies. Extra perks cause enemies that are killed by the Hammer of Sol to explode and chain fiery Solar damage to enemies caught in the blast or have the Hammer of Sol track its target. *Fleetfire: An extra perk that causes kills with solar abilities to grant the user bonus movement and reload speed for a short time. Cannot fight in spirit form in lower dimensions, and requires a physical vessel to not shatter it. Notable Attacks/Techniques: Authority ( Kennō): As a Primordial Goddess, Ishtar possess Divine Authorities, special powers distinct from Code Casts, Noble Phantasms, and Skills in that while they achieve results based on some logical process or principle, an Authority realizes a result simply because the user has the right to do so. Authorities are powers on the level of world construction, and can be powers such as event shifting, time manipulation, causality manipulation, kingdom-building and other powers on that level. The Gods originally used their Authorities during the Age of Gods to shape the world, build kingdoms and advance civilization. But as time went, humanity advanced to the point that Authorities became unnecessary. When summoned as a Servant, Ishtar likely cannot utilize her Authorities without harming and straining herself. The derivative version of Ishtar from our world possesses a total of seven Divine Authorities, and she also can take the Authorities of other Gods and Goddesses, and the primordial version of Ishtar should at least possess these as well. ===Noble Phantasm=== Edin Shugra Quasar: Royal Crown Shining in the Primeval Universe ( Edin Shugura Kuēsā?) Space Ishtar's own Noble Phantasm. She begins by summoning the ancient Bel Maanna temple, the "testimony of the goddess" from the primordial universe, before unleashing the higher-dimensional soul that composes it and generating an entire galaxy to turn into energy, firing it as a volatile projectile with enough power to obliterate entire cosmic domains. The temple, a Baal temple built by Anat, has a horrifying shape and offensive form, or so it is said. In the Sumer-Akkad language, "Edin" refers to the sky, and is said to be the source of the Old Testament's Eden. Shugra was the crown found in said Edin, given to Ishtar when she entered the domain. Quasar refers to the modern word for interstellar objects, a cosmic domain away from the Earth, emitting an extremely strong light and being called "the brightest celestial body". ===Class Skills=== *Avenger ( Fukushū-sha): The signature class skill of Avengers, representing the existence of one who gathers the grudges and hatred of others and takes it onto themselves. By chance, Ishtar's name of Astarte was corrupted by later Europe into the demon Astaroth, turning her from a goddess who was worshipped into a monster who was demonized. Filled with anger, pain and self-pity, her rank in this skill is an astounding EX. *Independent Action ( Tandoku Kōdō): The ability to remain independent and exist in the world without the magical energy supplied by a Master, allowing the Servant to act autonomously and the Master to save their own magical energy for spells. As an individual born as a goddess, raised as a human, and developed as a Servant, Ishtar's existence in the world takes virtually no mana, even when she's not contracted to a Master. *Magic Resistance ( Tai-Maryoku): An innate ability that grants protection against magical effects. Unlike the Resistance effect that merely rejects Magical Energy, this ability cancels the spells altogether. Ishtar's mediocre C-rank protects her from spells with two verses or less, but will be unable to protect her from High-Thaumaturgy or Greater Rituals. *Oblivion Correction ( Bōkyaku Hosei): An Avenger never forgets, attacking from beyond oblivion with greater strength than other Servants, increasing the power of their blows whenever they strike an opponent's weak points. No matter how much time passes or how many things she's exposed to, Ishtar's own hatred will never lessen. *Self-Replenishment (Mana) ( () Jiko Kaifuku (Maryoku)): One of the class skills of the Avenger, allowing them to continuously replenish their mana until their task is completed. ===Personal Skills=== * Devil's Sugar (デビルズ・シュガー Debiruzu Shugā): Even with her status as a demon paining her, Ishtar still makes full use of its "charm and excitement" with this skill. By smiling and blowing a kiss, she can increase her allies' morale and allow them to ignore any of their body's limitations to release power beyond their normal limits. Her own charm/curse is also capable of nullifying an enemy's charm when used on her allies. In a combination of the goddess of victory and the one who will destroy humanity, it could be called a devil's charisma. *Goddess' Divine Core (の Megami no Kamikaku): A skill that denotes Ishtar as a perfected goddess from birth, it preserves the absoluteness of her mind and body, repelling all mental interference while preventing her body from ageing or changing no matter how many calories she consumes. It's a composite skill that also includes divinity allowing her to reduce "Anti-Purge defense" in proportion to the rank of her Divinity, allowing her to break through defensive abilities such as Protection of the Faith and Saver's Enlightenment of the Sacred Fig.

Extra perks allow the user to increases the duration and strength of the shield created by Disintegrate. *Magnetic Grenade: A grenade that attaches to enemies and explodes twice. Designed to crack the armour of hard targets. *Spike Grenade: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging void light. *Suppressor Grenade: An explosive grenade that prevents enemies from using abilities for a short time. *Voidwall Grenade: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light. *Iron Harvest: Heavy Weapon kills have a chance to create Orbs of Light for the users allies. Code of the Protector: *Ward of Dawn: The Code of the Protector allows the user to forego summoning the Sentinel Shield, and instead shape Void Light into a nigh-indestructible shield-dome to protect the user and their allies from harm. Ward of Dawn can be tweaked to dramatically amplify the durability or attack potency of its user and any allies who pass through it, with other perks further increasing the potency of the buffs. Extra perks allow the user to either increase the Ward of Dawn's duration as well as their own base durability, give the Ward the ability to generate additional Orbs of Light when it is under enemy fire or dramatically decrease the cooldown time of the Ward of Dawn and give a small boost to the users base durability. *Defensive Strike: Killing an enemy with this melee ability to creates an overshield around the user and nearby allies. *Rallying Force: Killing an enemy in melee restores health for the user and nearby allies. *Turn the Tide: The overshield from Defensive Strike lasts longer and increases melee damage and reload speed. Code of the Aggressor: *Superior Arsenal: Grenade kills recharge grenade energy. *Shield Bash: After sprinting for a short time, using this melee ability unleashes a devastating Shield Bash that disorients enemies. *In The Trenches: Kills while surrounded by enemies reduce the cooldown of Sentinel Shield *Second Shield: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active. *Hammer of Sol: Forges Light into a raging inferno of Solar energy, and allows the user to pull a blazing hammer from the fire. The user can then launch their hammers at enemies from afar, releasing a devastating eruption of Solar fire on impact. Perks give the user the ability to throw more hammers as well as the hammers causing bigger explosions and allow the user to hurl themselves forward during Hammer of Sol, causing enemies in their path explode, chaining fiery damage to other enemies. Extra perks cause enemies that are killed by the Hammer of Sol to explode and chain fiery Solar damage to enemies caught in the blast or have the Hammer of Sol track its target. *Fleetfire: An extra perk that causes kills with solar abilities to grant the user bonus movement and reload speed for a short time. None notable Note #1: Saint Alagadda is not just a “true form” of the Hanged King or the Ambassador of Alagadda, but is rather portrayed as an entirely different entity, stated to be stated to be the city’s namesake and the one guiding the fate of Alagadda’s true unmasked nature, described as “the city as it was before the corruption of the King and its people” and “the city as it will be, when the Ambassador abdicates, when history ends, when the last note is played”. The Saint would scale above these characters anyway, as they would be encompassed within the Saint’s creation, however the Trashfire/On Mount Golgotha version of the Hanged King wouldn’t scale to the Hanged King from other canons due to cosmology differences. Note #2: Saint Alagadda does not scale to SCP-3812 in any capacity, as the song mentioned in 3812’s article was never implied to have any connection to On Mount Golgotha or the Saint, and Djkaktus has stated that 3812’s “song” is simply a metaphor for his own agony. ==Explanations== Saint Alagadda is the supreme being of the On Mount Golgotha canon, however unfortunately this doesn’t scale anywhere on its own, as this particular canon never elaborates on its own cosmology beyond vague details like the existence of the Ways or the Kingdom of Alagadda. As such, we have to look to other sources to gain additional context. The main author of the Trashfire canon, UraniumEmpire, has stated that the On Mount Golgotha canon is the First Hytoth within the world of Trashfire. In the same quote, she states that another one her tales, Qlippoth and Sefiros is the origin story of Trashfire’s cosmology. From this, we can gather that QaS, Trashfire, and On Mount Golgotha all share a cosmology. Admittedly this is one-way canonicity, the fact that On Mount Golgotha is canon to Trashfire doesn’t automatically make Trashfire canon to On Mount Golgotha. However, it’s the best information we have, since again, On Mount Golgotha only has a cosmology in the context of Trashfire. Technically, we don't know where a "pure" On Mount Golgotha version of Saint Alagadda would scale, what we're really talking about here is the Trashfire version. UraniumEmpire has also stated she doesn’t know who Saint Alagadda is, meaning they weren't part of her "intent" when writing Trashfire and QaS. However, this doesn’t mean the Saint can’t exist in Trashfire, since they exist as an integral part of the On Mount Golgotha mythos, which UraniumEmpire incorporated into the Trashfire series as the First Hytoth. That is to say, it doesn’t actually if the author was specifically thinking about the Saint when writing Trashfire and QaS, they’re implicitly part of that mythos anyway by virtue of Trashfire’s connection with On Mount Golgotha. While author statements can be a considered a secondary source of information, their weight can be called into question when they contradict other evidence, as is the case here. ==Gallery== Put other pictures of the character here. ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: Category:Stratovariant

The death does not have to be immediate, nor do they have to be revived in the same place they died. Ghosts may also repair any injury a Guardian suffers in a matter of seconds. *Sparrow: A Sparrow is a single-passenger, all-terrain antigrav bike with one purpose: moving from objective to objective with unmatched speed. Sparrows are quick, quiet, and simple to transmat. *Saint-14's Gray Pigeon: A one-seat Guardian jumpship, Saint-14's personal aircraft uses a City-standard NLS Drive that bends space around the vehicle for almost instantaneous travel between planets. Feats: *Became famous for his actions at the Battle of Six Fronts. *Became the first Vanguard, and helped establish the Consensus system that still runs The City in present. *Led crusades against the Fallen, resulting in the death of Solkis, Kell of the House of Devils. *Fought the Vex for centuries, ending his life with a mutual kill on a mind dedicated to the sole purpose of his demise. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Lift: A Titan ability allowing for limited flight. Different codices will focus on one, two or all of the three traits, amplifying them in the user depending on which traits the user needs in any specific battle. *Sentinel Shield: Summons a shield of Void Light. While Sentinel Shield is active, the user can hit opponents with the shield, throw the shield while creating a new one in the process, or guard with the shield, greatly expanding the radius it covers. Extra perks allow the user to increases the duration and strength of the shield created by Disintegrate. *Magnetic Grenade: A grenade that attaches to enemies and explodes twice. Designed to crack the armour of hard targets. *Spike Grenade: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging void light. *Suppressor Grenade: An explosive grenade that prevents enemies from using abilities for a short time. *Voidwall Grenade: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light. *Iron Harvest: Heavy Weapon kills have a chance to create Orbs of Light for the users allies. Code of the Protector: *Ward of Dawn: The Code of the Protector allows the user to forego summoning the Sentinel Shield, and instead shape Void Light into a nigh-indestructible shield-dome to protect the user and their allies from harm. Replenishes grenade and melee energy on activation. Ward of Dawn can be tweaked to dramatically amplify the durability or attack potency of its user and any allies who pass through it, with other perks further increasing the potency of the buffs. Extra perks allow the user to either increase the Ward of Dawn's duration as well as their own base durability, give the Ward the ability to generate additional Orbs of Light when it is under enemy fire or dramatically decrease the cooldown time of the Ward of Dawn and give a small boost to the users base durability. *Defensive Strike: Killing an enemy with this melee ability to creates an overshield around the user and nearby allies. *Rallying Force: Killing an enemy in melee restores health for the user and nearby allies. *Turn the Tide: The overshield from Defensive Strike lasts longer and increases melee damage and reload speed. Code of the Aggressor: *Superior Arsenal: Grenade kills recharge grenade energy. *Shield Bash: After sprinting for a short time, using this melee ability unleashes a devastating Shield Bash that disorients enemies. *In The Trenches: Kills while surrounded by enemies reduce the cooldown of Sentinel Shield *Second Shield: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active. *Hammer of Sol: Forges Light into a raging inferno of Solar energy, and allows the user to pull a blazing hammer from the fire. The user can then launch their hammers at enemies from afar, releasing a devastating eruption of Solar fire on impact. Perks give the user the ability to throw more hammers as well as the hammers causing bigger explosions and allow the user to hurl themselves forward during Hammer of Sol, causing enemies in their path explode, chaining fiery damage to other enemies. Extra perks cause enemies that are killed by the Hammer of Sol to explode and chain fiery Solar damage to enemies caught in the blast or have the Hammer of Sol track its target. *Fleetfire: An extra perk that causes kills with solar abilities to grant the user bonus movement and reload speed for a short time. She prefers to orchestrate and manipulate events from the shadows, and often employs subtler methods to get rid of her enemies and to take what she wants. She rarely shows herself to anyone, even her allies. Even when she takes a more direct approach to a conflict, she will often not be anywhere near it, or even in the same reality for that matter. She is however, fully capable of engaging in direct combat, as she has fought her siblings for billions of years, with one of their fights lasting for 20,000 years. Although she still specializes in manipulation, sabotage, subterfuge, etc. Savathûn is less averse to direct combat now. She continually and agressively uses powerful attacks of Void, Arc and Solar Light to kill her enemies. She can use Threadbound in order to temporarily debilitate targets, or set it up to activate when they try to attack her Ghost. Savathûn summons Projections of herself to aid her in battle. These Projections are capable of using the same Void, Arc and Solar Light abilities as Savathûn. She also continuously calls upon reinforcements from her brood. When she's fighting at full power, she'll deploy her Ward of Dawn, protecting herself against all ranged attacks and abilities. She is, however, also likely to let Projections fight in her place.

Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Acolyte Grenade: Savathûn conjures a solar magic explosive and throws it at the enemy. It explodes upon contact, leaving behind a pool of fire. *Darkness Blast: Savathûn fires darkness projectiles of the arc element. *Poison Cloud: Savathûn summons a dark cloud of poison on top of her enemies. These clouds deal damage over time, blur the enemy's senses, and slow them down. *IMBARU: IMBARU is a tribute system, created by Savathûn, an existential economy based on the accumulation of secrets and the tribute of failing-to-understand-her. Cunning is the use of thought to predict the function of a system. Therefore, wherever a being should attempt to understand Savathûn and fail, her cunning will have defeated theirs. Wherever a falsehood is repeated about her, she will have displayed cunning. Savathûn gathers tribute from every false prediction, misguided theory, fearful rumour, and ominous supposition which derives from the thought of her. *Savathûn's Song: A viral chant that can never be unheard. It can be spread through different mediums, such as through binary code. Anyone under its effects is open to further mental manipulation by Savathûn. *Deepsight: The ability to see beyond the limitations of normal sight. It's a psychic power that allows the user to see psychic imprints of past events. Due to the Darkness being bound to the consciousness that stretches in webs across space and time, the ability is uniquely useful for investigatory processes. With Deepsight one can see through illusions, unveil hidden things and manifest things from the past. The latter is useful for making objects remember their shape, such as returning a broken glaive to a pristine state. *Inquisition of Self: A heretical technique that allows one to excise the layers of self and to navigate the dissection of living essences. It can be used to exorcise a being from their body, though this requires wounds to function as openings, and to transfer the essence and consciousness of a being to another body. It can be used to let a living essence vanish into the aether or to preserve it as a means of reviving them, as is shown with Zulmak. Savathûn can also use it to heal others. *Hive Annihilation Ritual: Savathûn casts a Hive ritual that instantly kills all targets within a large area. *Ontological Warhead: Savathûn channels her power into a single point and releases an ontological attack with a large area of effect. *Summon Void Crystals: Savathûn summons multiple Void Crystals and subsequently has them explode through Void Detonation if they're not quickly destroyed. *Summon Deceptions: Savathûn creates illusions of herself or of others that are capable of affecting reality, as they can cast Hive magic. These illusions must be destroyed in order to expose the real one. *Incendiary Rune: One of the many Hive runes Savathûn can use. With it, she can fire powerful projectiles of Solar energy. *Blade Barrage: Savathûn conjures several blades of Solar Light and launches them, manipulating their trajectory in order to strike the target. *Nova Bomb: Savathûn launches a dense orb of Void Light that releases a gravitational blast upon impact and leaves behind a singularity of Void Light. *Nova Warp: Savathûn releases a powerful explosion of Void Light directly from her body. *Vicious Light: Savathûn rapid-fires blasts of Arc Light at her target. *Stormtrance: Savathûn calls forth multiple outwards travelling columns of Arc Light. *Ward of Dawn: Savathûn creates a large barrier of Void Light that moves with her at its center. It doesn't stop attacks or enemies from passing through, but it does make Savathûn completely immune to attacks and abilities that originate from outside of the barrier. *Threadbound: Savathûn casts Light-based magic that restricts the target's ability to take action. *The Power to Move Worlds: The ability from which the power to Take is derived. It involves reforming matter in a self-contained reality, where the creator defines past, present, and future. It can transport targets to other locations, including other planes of existence, and potentially outside of space and time. It can create shifts in reality large enough to move entire planets. Note: Savathûn's fourth key is exclusively for her feats within her throne world because she has no notable feats outside of it. ==Gallery== File:DestinyThreeSisters.jpg|Sathona, Xi Ro and Aurash File:Sathona2.jpeg|Sath

intelligence.text: Supergenius (The Witness is one of the most intelligent and knowledgeable beings in the universe, more so than even the likes of the Daughters of Oryx and Savathûn, the Witch Queen. It integrated itself with, and is the greatest user of, the Darkness, an ontological force far beyond even axioms that govern entire planes of existence. Its Pyramid technology can manipulate the Calabi-Yau manifold for various purposes, such as instantaneous communication and folding space-time away into the extra six dimensions. An artifact of the Black Fleet could not be described by Golden Age researchers without diminishing it: a black sphere—nothing could be simpler—and yet it is unspeakably complex, compactly infinite, full of as many things as it could possibly contain. Through studying the Traveler and the Veil, the Witness discovered how it could achieve the Final Shape and reconfigure the universe, including an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, which requires a complete understanding of the universe. Is made from the billions of minds of the Precursors, who were an extremely advanced civilizationEntelechy - page 7 & 8)

The Witness｢｣ – A parameter of existence that defines Aster as the universe's first act of self-awareness. Without this "witnessing," reality lacks the logical necessity to exist. This allows Aster to maintain the stability of the Fourth Universe simply by being present. Legibility Calibration｢｣ – A process where Aster compresses his vast, prior existence into a form that lower beings can receive without the act of witnessing him destroying the receiver. This allows him to interact with "Tier 2 and 3" cosmic judges while remaining unclassifiable. Editorial Decision｢｣ – In his higher states, Aster does not deliver force or engage in combat. Instead, he makes "editorial decisions" about whether a target continues to exist in its current form. Because he predates the rules of reality, these decisions bypass all forms of conventional durability and resistance. The Great Existence｢｣ – The removal of the translation layer. Aster is not a being within the universe; the universe is a feature of him. He is the page, and reality is the text. In this state, instruments fail because they are trying to measure the very thing they exist inside of. Total Understanding｢｣ – An effect projected onto those who witness Aster's true form. They receive a complete, unambiguous answer to the nature of existence, filling all conceptual voids and rendering further questions or conflict irrelevant. The First Atom｢｣ – Aster remembers the silence before the first atom. This ability allows him to revert any object or conceptual entity back to the state of "prior to creation," effectively undoing their existence. The Persistent One｢｣ – An anchor ability that prevents the Fourth Universe from collapsing like the three prior universes. As long as Aster remains, the universe "wants" to continue. Margin Note｢｣ – Aster exists in the "margins" of every event. He can manipulate the subtext of any battle or conversation, ensuring he is present but never fully targeted unless he chooses to be. The Dead Language｢｣ – Using the fragments of ancient, forgotten human languages, Aster can speak "Stars" and "Carrying" into existence, manifesting conceptual objects that remain longer than mathematics can hold. Only I Can Kill｢｣ – The final revelation. Aster is the only being in existence capable of being "killed" because he is the only being with the power to withdraw his own witnessing. It is an absolute form of self-erasure that ends the story itself. Ontological Denial｢｣ – Due to his status as the substrate of reality, Aster has absolute resistance to any influence that originates from within the universe's framework. He cannot be erased, rewritten, or harmed by powers that rely on the laws of the First, Second, Third, or Fourth Universes, as those laws were established after him. Conceptual Inaccessibility｢｣ – Attempts to understand or classify Aster fail because he precedes all categories. His mental and physical state are unreachable by those who exist inside the system he maintains. == Attributes
Boundless (Operates through editorial decisions. He is the reason there is something to ask questions in; his "attacks" are structural shifts in the substrate of existence itself.)
Immeasurable (Exists beyond linear time. He does not travel; he allocates focused presence across all points of the four universes and the Margin simultaneously.)
Boundless (Precedes the framework where harm is possible. Destroying the "story" of the universe does not affect the "page" that is Aster Dray.)

None Notable == Notable Feats == * Survival of the Triple Collapse: Persisted through the end of the first three universal iterations, including the "sentence that lost confidence halfway through." * The Tribunal Observation: Remained unclassified by Tier 2 and Tier 3 cosmic judges, ultimately proving that their instruments were measuring from inside his own existence. * Cael’s Enlightenment: Granted a younger god total understanding of existence simply by allowing himself to be witnessed, ending a direct conflict without a single strike. Through this, Vergil has numerous ways to use his summoned swords, whether for attacking his enemies from a distance, surrounding them with it or from atop, or having the blades move around himself for defense and attack enemies get too close to him. Judgement Cut: A signature move Vergil performs with his Yamato. By using the space-cutting properties of the sword, Vergil can attack his enemies from a distance by cutting through the air, where it sends a dark distortion that is then covered in slashes, cutting anyone caught in it to shreds. Vergil can also send multiple Judgement Cuts in rapid succession. * Judgement Cut End: A more powerful variation of Judgement Cut, where Vergil readies up his sword and then moves forward at such speeds to leave after-images behind. Such a move allows him to cover the area in his slashes, allowing him to take out large numbers of enemies in one full sweep. Hell on Earth: By concentrating his demonic/magic powers on his hand and slamming than in the ground with a mighty punch, Vergil can create a powerful AOE attack that can cause devastating attacks on his enemies. Deep Stinger: A forward lunge using both Yamato and Mirage Edge, with all the strength of his body and soul behind them. Note: Vergil's optional equipment comes from the canonical mobile game Peak of Combat, but the mechanics of the game fall into the Optional Equipment rules set by RPG characters with no distinct/set of weaponry they use above all other potential items they may have, being completely in the choosing of the player. Base Devil Trigger: Vergil's natural Devil Trigger gained sometime before his reunion with Dante. This Devil Trigger is the most basic of the Devil Trigger forms and can be accessed anytime Vergil wishes without a Devil Arm. In addition, it gives Vergil a balanced boost to all stats. * Sin Devil Trigger: The Strongest Devil Form that Vergil has access. He gained it after his human and demon selves reunited together into one. It is a powerful form that awakens his true inner demonic heritage. It gives Vergil a further dramatic increase in attack, range, defense, speed, and regeneration. Additionally, he also gains the ability to fly and even create a doppelganger that can replicate all of his moves or act independently. }} |-|Notable Attacks/Techniques= Summoned Swords: As said before, Vergil can summon spectral blades that resemble the form of the Force Edge. Through this, Vergil has numerous ways to use his summoned swords, whether for attacking his enemies from a distance, surrounding them with it or from atop, or having the blades move around himself for defense and attack enemies get too close to him. Judgement Cut: A signature move Vergil performs with his Yamato. By using the space-cutting properties of the sword, Vergil can attack his enemies from a distance by cutting through the air, where it sends a dark distortion that is then covered in slashes, cutting anyone caught in it to shreds. Vergil can also send multiple Judgement Cuts in rapid succession. * Judgement Cut End: A more powerful variation of Judgement Cut, where Vergil readies up his sword and then moves forward at such speeds to leave after-images behind. Such a move allows him to cover the area in his slashes, allowing him to take out large numbers of enemies in one full sweep. Hell on Earth: By concentrating his demonic/magic powers on his hand and slamming than in the ground with a mighty punch, Vergil can create a powerful AOE attack that can cause devastating attacks on his enemies. Deep Stinger: A forward lunge using both Yamato and Mirage Edge, with all the strength of his body and soul behind them. Note: Vergil's optional equipment comes from the canonical mobile game Peak of Combat, but the mechanics of the game fall into the Optional Equipment rules set by RPG characters with no distinct/set of weaponry they use above all other potential items they may have, being completely in the choosing of the player. He gained it after his human and demon selves reunited together into one. It is a powerful form that awakens his true inner demonic heritage. It gives Vergil a further dramatic increase in attack, range, defense, speed, and regeneration. Additionally, he also gains the ability to fly and even create a doppelganger that can replicate all of his moves or act independently. }} |-|Notable Attacks/Techniques= Summoned Swords: As said before, Vergil can summon spectral blades that resemble the form of the Force Edge. Through this, Vergil has numerous ways to use his summoned swords, whether for attacking his enemies from a distance, surrounding them with it or from atop, or having the blades move around himself for defense and attack enemies get too close to him. Judgement Cut: A signature move Vergil performs with his Yamato. By using the space-cutting properties of the sword, Vergil can attack his enemies from a distance by cutting through the air, where it sends a dark distortion that is then covered in slashes, cutting anyone caught in it to shreds. Vergil can also send multiple Judgement Cuts in rapid succession. * Judgement Cut End: A more powerful variation of Judgement Cut, where Vergil readies up his sword and then moves forward at such speeds to leave after-images behind. Such a move allows him to cover the area in his slashes, allowing him to take out large numbers of enemies in one full sweep. Hell on Earth: By concentrating his demonic/magic powers on his hand and slamming than in the ground with a mighty punch, Vergil can create a powerful AOE attack that can cause devastating attacks on his enemies. Deep Stinger: A forward lunge using both Yamato and Mirage Edge, with all the strength of his body and soul behind them. Note: Vergil's optional equipment comes from the canonical mobile game Peak of Combat, but the mechanics of the game fall into the Optional Equipment rules set by RPG characters with no distinct/set of weaponry they use above all other potential items they may have, being completely in the choosing of the player. | |-|Yamato= center|thumb|200px|Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition, Devil Arms File — Yamato: "A memento from Vergil’s father. This samurai-esque sword’s blade is said to cut through anything." This is Vergil's primary weapon Yamato. It ignores conventional durability. Examples of this are when Yamato pierced through Nero's Devil Bringer which was supposed to be an indestructible demonic arm. And cut open a dimensional wall to aid Dante against Arkham, and has many showings of spatial cutting. Yamato has also been shown to be capable of slicing targets dozens of meters away with ease. |-|Beowulf= center|thumb|250px|Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition, Devil Arms File — Beowulf: "Flash gauntlets and greaves. This set boosts Vergil’s attack and speed, making him a powerhouse." Flash gauntlets and greaves, which had enough power to launch Beowulf into the air from an uppercut and slice him in half with an axe kick. It also demonstrates Vergil's skill in hand-to-hand combat. Lunar Phase and Beowulf Combo B. |-|Force Edge= centre|thumb|200px|Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition, Devil Arms File — Force Edge: "A sword magically imbued with Sparda's power. A powerful sword with great hidden potential." A blade similar in power to Rebellion. It is the sealed form of the sword wielded by Sparda himself; Vergil dual-wields it with Yamato in combat. Vergil is capable of throwing the Force Edge with such power; it creates a whirlwind vacuum and sucks any enemies in carving them up. Vergil is also capable of stabbing at tremendously high speeds with this weapon. Vergil can also use energy slashes when wielding Force Edge. |-|Summoned Swords= centre|thumb|150px| Devil May Cry 4, Yamato — Summoned Swords: "Summon a magical blade and fling it towards a foe, piercing the enemy through sheer force of will. Vergil conjures a spectral sword that bears a resemblance to Force Edge and launches it at high speeds against his enemies. Vergil is skilled in their usage circling himself with the blades and being able to shoot them out afterward if he wants, being able to summon them to surround an enemy eventually impaling them and making them rain towards an enemy also. He has also shown that he can create swords of different sizes and can wield one himself. |-|Mirage Edge= centre|thumb|250px| Devil May Cry 5: Special Edition, Mirage Edge: A weapon shaped from Vergil's own infernal energy. There's something about this blade—its shape and attacks—that resembles Force Edge, the sword his father wielded so long ago. Vergil conjures a spectral sword that bears a resemblance to Force Edge, except this time to use for offensive combat instead of using it as a ranged projectile, dual-wielding it alongside Yamato. Vergil uses it in the same exact manner as he used the Force Edge, using it as a replacement. |}

Base Devil Trigger: Vergil's natural Devil Trigger gained sometime before his reunion with Dante. This Devil Trigger is the most basic of the Devil Trigger forms and can be accessed anytime Vergil wishes without a Devil Arm. In addition, it gives Vergil a balanced boost to all stats. * Sin Devil Trigger: The Strongest Devil Form that Vergil has access. He gained it after his human and demon selves reunited together into one. It is a powerful form that awakens his true inner demonic heritage. It gives Vergil a further dramatic increase in attack, range, defense, speed, and regeneration. Additionally, he also gains the ability to fly and even create a doppelganger that can replicate all of his moves or act independently. }} |-|Notable Attacks/Techniques= Summoned Swords: As said before, Vergil can summon spectral blades that resemble the form of the Force Edge. Through this, Vergil has numerous ways to use his summoned swords, whether for attacking his enemies from a distance, surrounding them with it or from atop, or having the blades move around himself for defense and attack enemies get too close to him. Judgement Cut: A signature move Vergil performs with his Yamato. By using the space-cutting properties of the sword, Vergil can attack his enemies from a distance by cutting through the air, where it sends a dark distortion that is then covered in slashes, cutting anyone caught in it to shreds. Vergil can also send multiple Judgement Cuts in rapid succession. * Judgement Cut End: A more powerful variation of Judgement Cut, where Vergil readies up his sword and then moves forward at such speeds to leave after-images behind. Such a move allows him to cover the area in his slashes, allowing him to take out large numbers of enemies in one full sweep. Hell on Earth: By concentrating his demonic/magic powers on his hand and slamming than in the ground with a mighty punch, Vergil can create a powerful AOE attack that can cause devastating attacks on his enemies. Deep Stinger: A forward lunge using both Yamato and Mirage Edge, with all the strength of his body and soul behind them. Note: Vergil's optional equipment comes from the canonical mobile game Peak of Combat, but the mechanics of the game fall into the Optional Equipment rules set by RPG characters with no distinct/set of weaponry they use above all other potential items they may have, being completely in the choosing of the player. Examples of this are when Yamato pierced through Nero's Devil Bringer which was supposed to be an indestructible demonic arm.
